definitions.explanation: An examination to measure knowledge or ability. From English 'test.'

examples.japanese: {明日|あした}テストがあります。
テストは{難|むずか}しかったです。
テストの{勉強|べんきょう}をしなければなりません。
examples.english: I have to study for the test.

notes: テスト is commonly used for classroom tests. 試験 (しけん) is more formal and used for important exams like entrance exams. 小テスト means quiz. Japanese students face intense pressure from entrance exams (入試 にゅうし).
